content: MK writes that among his minor lettrist treatises Ibn Turka's R. Suʾl al-Mulūk appears to be the only one with pointedly political content, fitting its subject and addressee: it was written in or before 829/1426 at Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh's request as an introductory work on both the practical-magical (e.g., alchemical and talismanic) and the theoretical aspects of lettrism, giving a broader overview than his other lettrist treatises.
